name: We are the Literature Club
storyline: "We are The Literature Club" is a fan-made visual novel that reimagines the world of Doki Doki Literature Club. Rather than focusing on psychological horror, this story takes a more heartfelt and grounded approach, exploring themes of friendship, self-expression, and emotional healing. You join the Literature Club once again, but this time, the atmosphere is more supportive, and the characters are given space to grow and connect in new ways. It's a refreshing take that honors the original while crafting its own identity.
summary: This story was created to continue on the story of the Literature Club, and to give the girls the ending that they deserved, as well as the closure that the player thought they would never get.Set in an alternate canon, where the meddlings of the class president never took place, We are the Literature Club carries on the story by laying a new foundation in storytelling, eventually culminating in the revival of the Literature Club for a new era.With a small cast of new characters, and familiar ones, We are the Literature Club sets the stage for an enjoyable "re-write" of the world of Doki Doki Literature Club, with a slight twist in an alternate timeline.After all that happened; are you really willing to let it end there?"
